notes.title: Chess Remix Online
notes.content: Now you can play against real players in our competitive online section. Play chess, xiangqui or shogi. You can also play "Chess Mix" which gives you a random remix of chess.

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Chess Remix is now playable in many new languages

[list]
[*] New release includes correction to Shogi promotion and other bug fixes.
[*] A new enhanced ai
[*] Interface improvements
[/list]
